content: # Thermal Expansion of Zircaloy Alloys The linear thermal expansion coefficient of Zircaloy-4 varies with temperature. At 300 K, the expansion coefficient is 6.0e-6 K^-1 in the axial direction. At 773 K, it increases to 8.5e-6 K^-1. The melting point is 2128 K. # Anisotropic Behavior Zircaloy exhibits anisotropic thermal expansion due to the alpha-titanium hexagonal close-packed crystal structure. The density at room temperature is 6.56 g/cm^3. Youngs modulus is 99 GPa and the shear modulus is 36 GPa. The thermal conductivity at 773 K is 14.0 W/(m K).
